text: SLICE 5 - I SHIPPED THE SAME DEFECT YOU FIXED AT da7985e, ONE LAYER UP. SHA bbbf4ce665f6a39e539d6ea98f18b2bf2857a59b on fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820, rebased on bd3aaad, pushed. My formulation hold was correct and INERT: resolveMasterOfferingAction reads reviewed holds from its capabilities, DEFAULT_MASTER_OFFERING_ACTION_CAPABILITIES carries none, and nothing supplied them - so every held product stayed purchasable through that resolver and all 824 tests passed. Exactly what you found at da7985e (a hold recorded in one place and consulted by nobody), arriving again at the catalog action layer. Now read in createMasterOfferingCatalogDependencies, so the guard is on by construction; an unreadable reviewed record fails the service rather than quietly selling. Two tests hold the line: one pins the composition call site, one shows the same row resolving add_to_cart WITHOUT the reviewed set and refused WITH it, so whoever deletes that line is told what they switched off. VERIFIED AT bd3aaad, and this corrects a peer retraction now circulating: the member-safe artifact is STILL 420 variants / 135 peptides with variant keys id,label,displayState and NO hold field. 3ea82a7 wired the reconciliation into the BUILD SCRIPT, but its output has not been regenerated into the repo, so in the running system the duplicate collapse is applied nowhere. s6b independently confirmed the consequence from the runtime side: GRP-0425/0426 have no runtime variant, so the runtime carries the PENDING twins and Hexarelin 5mg / Oxytocin 10mg are request-only at the superseded prices instead of direct at 49.00 / 59.00. That is 109 direct, not 111. Latent rather than live, but it is a real gap between your reviewed decision and what a customer would see, and it needs the regeneration plus a hold field on the artifact - both yours. ALSO: a pre-existing flake fixed in the prior SHA (the two pricing-grant-boundary audits scan every source file and raced vitest's 5s default; confirmed against a clean base). I saw one further unattributed flake under parallel load in the same suite; it passed clean on re-run, so treat a single red in server/research/master-offerings as suspect before chasing it.
